# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]

### [What is wAIHA?][211]

Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA) causes fatigue so profound, it can limit the lives of
people who have the condition. Learn more about this rare disease and a potential targeted treatment
developed by Johnson & Johnson that’s currently in clinical trials.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

into a single forecast you can act on.

# For health **with humanity**

 

 

## Hello.
## We are **Haleon.**

Haleon is a consumer company that is solely focused on better everyday health. Our people, our
brands, our research, our investment and our innovation are aimed at improving the everyday health
of consumers, throughout all stages of their lives.

[ Get to know us ][144]
[Image of Sensodyne Repair toothpaste and toothbrush]

On 13 March, we published our Annual Report and Form 20-F 2025.
 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][145]
[Our brands]

We work to put better everyday health in more hands through our superior brands, including
Sensodyne, Advil and Centrum.

[ Our brands ][146]
[Our strategy]

Through our Win as One strategy, we aim to reach one billion more consumers by 2030 and deliver
industry-leading shareholder returns.

[ Our strategy ][147]

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

# Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence Platform

Compare drug prices, suppliers, registrations, and shortages across global pharmaceutical markets.

BOOK A PLATFORM DEMO
[product preview] Your browser does not support the video tag.

PharmaFootpath unifies global drug pricing, supplier data, registrations, shortages, and clinical
trial information into a single searchable platform. Instantly reveal market opportunities,
empowering procurement teams, wholesalers, and parallel traders to act quickly and confidently
across countries.

[MYONEX]
[RxSource]
[Eureco Pharma]
[Ideal Trade Links]
[Corex]
[Tanner Pharma]
[Ikris Pharma Network]
[Kora Healthcare]

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

## See how PharmaFootpath works in your market

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

Monitoring drug shortages is an important task, but the volume of information can be difficult to
manage.

PharmaFootpath collects and structures shortage information into a single interface, monitoring
trends to highlight the API with which there are increasing supply disruption signals.

## Built for Pharmaceutical Trade and Procurement

### Procurement Teams

Procurement teams can efficiently search multiple markets, compare pricing, and identify suppliers.

### Parallel Traders

Parallel traders can track product registrations, monitor competition, and find arbitrage
opportunities across EU markets.

### Clinical Trial Supply Teams

Clinical trial supply teams can identify global product availability and find new sourcing
opportunities.

### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers

Pharmaceutical wholesalers can find new suppliers, partners, and international trade opportunities.

## Find sourcing opportunities across global pharmaceutical markets

Schedule a Demo

## Official Pharmaceutical Sources

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
databases, and verified sources. Shortage data is updated daily, and most datasets are refreshed
weekly, so users have the latest information.
* Pharmaceutical pricing
* Product registrations
* Shortages and supply disruptions
* Clinical trials
* Supplier licenses

## Trusted by Pharmaceutical Trade Professionals

> Pharma Footpath has become a valuable part of how we shape our sourcing strategy for commercial
> drugs in clinical trials. The platform gives us clear visibility of the supply landscape including
> product availability, pricing dynamics, and emerging shortages, which helps us make more informed,
> proactive sourcing decisions. It has also strengthened our internal knowledge base and improved
> how we anticipate and manage sourcing challenges.

Matt Grace

Senior Directo

# [Ebola Update: Outbreak Continues To Worsen, At Least 930 Have Died][12]

by [Mac Slavo][13] | Jul 21, 2026 | [Health][14] | 0 Comments

The Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus that is currently spreading in the Democratic Republic of
Congo is continuing to spread, as health care workers struggle to contain the outbreak. At least 930

shrink tube.”

### Terrible service!

“Their customer service agents (if any) reply using templates that are unrelated to your
question(s). They provide you with unhelpful answers which makes you wonder if anyone is really at
the other end of the line. Plus, they use unreliable delivery services. Currently experiencing a
delivery delay (hopefully a delay) with my last order. I reached out to them and they made no effort
to look into the issue or communicate with this third party that they choose to do business
with...My parcel has been in transit for 7 business days now. They referred me to the carrier... and
how convenient was it to find out that the carrier's "Contact us" section doesn't work!”

[Andrew L's avatar][Andrew L.][22] on True Classic Tees

### Fantastic shirts, fantastic customer service

“Bought 9 shirts that fit so well and feel so good that it will be hard for them not be my go-to
shirts from now on. One shirt came with a stitching defect on the right sleeve which I took a
picture of and emailed to customer service and in less than 24 hours without any question, I receive
a shipping notification that a replacement is being sent out to me at no charge. Customer service
reached out to me afterwards to ensure everything else met my expectations. As incredibly difficult
it is these days to have good customer service from small and large companies alike, it was a breath
of fresh air to have been helped by this team.”

[Julie R's avatar][Julie R.][23] on [PatPat][24]

### Love the products, but very slow to ship!

“I love the products! The only issue I have that will keep me from ordering is the turn around after
placing an order is VERY slow! I placed multiple orders this Spring and just received all of my
orders 8-10 weeks later! When selling baby products, 2+ months shipping is unreasonable.”

[Anna Christina M's avatar][Anna Christina M.][25] on [PinkBlush][26]

### Super quick shipping, but quality could be better

“PinkBlush shipped out my package the day I put in the order. I received it two days later and I
didn't even choose express! I was definitely impressed. I bought two dresses which were super cute,
but to be honest, with what they're charging, I was expecting better quality. There were quite a few
hem strings and the fabric on both dresses is thinner than I was expecting. I got these dresses on
sale and with a gift card, but I don't think I'll be buying anything at full price.”

[Chris's avatar][Chris.][27] on [etrailer][28]

### Found a better alternative for the 12 volt power feed!

“I purchased the trailer wiring harness for a 2015 Dodge Dart. I read all of the reviews and found
that most people complained about having to route the 12 volt power feed from the battery. I spent a
lot of time searching forums about this problem and finally found a solution. The manufacturer has a
spare Red with Black tracer wire bundled in the rear driver side taillight wiring. The wire runs
from the fuse box inside the engine compartment. You have to look for a wire that is capped with
shrink tube.”

[Daniel C's avatar][Daniel C.][29] on [Ticketmaster][30]

### A scam of the highest order

“I bought tickets for a birthday present, under the terms that the tickets would be mailed via UPS.
Time passed. No tickets. The month of the show, they changed the tickets to Will Call, without
notice or consent. I live out of state and cannot pick them up as it was never an event that I
planned on attending. Now, due to their complete failure, the tickets are useless to me. Worse, they
have the worst customer service I've ever dealt with. No phones. Just bots in a chat who refuse to
acknowledge their mistakes, let alone fix them. No comps. They scammed me out of $600. Please I beg
you to purchase tickets elsewhere. Ticketmaster is a dangerous company.”

[David B's avatar][David B.][31] on [Amazon][32]

### Great quality products at a good price

“I have been using amazon.com to get supplies and products for over a year now. While the customer
service should be improved, I never had any problems regarding deliveries and product quality. Item
always matched description, which is a plus. Personally would recommend given the price/quality
ratio and the fast delivery.”

[Don S's avatar][Don S.][33] on [Goldbelly][34]

### Love ordering from them!

“I do love ordering from you and do so quite frequently. This one did not work out. The food got
delayed and arrived with the ice packs completely melted and the food spoiled. I do appreciate your
customer service representative who quickly arranged to replace the food. I am awaiting that
shipment now.”

[Leigh O's avatar][Leigh O.][35] on [FASHIONPHILE][36]

### Always on point

“Every purchase I make from Fashionphile is so easy. They offer different ways to purchase if you
don't want to pay in full upfront ( layaway and affirm) which I appreciate, and the description of
the bag and its condition is always spot on, if not in fact better ( as they are very picky and
detailed when describing the imperfections). I know exactly when my bag will arrive with the
tracking email they send, which is helpful because I have to sign for it, and if for some reason I
need to return it, they make that very seamless. Fashionphile is always my go-to site for vintage
and resale bags.”

[Maria B's avatar][Maria B.][37] on [Canva][38]

### Wonderful website/ tools for creators

“I use Canva to create my personal and business Facebook Banners, Instagram promotion content,
invoice creation, YouTube Banners and thumbnails, Planner Pages and sooo much more! Using Canva has
helped me gain a much more professional presence online. There is both a free edition as well as a
monthly/yearly membership option. You can also cancel anytime should you need to. There are so many
things you can create on Canva and I love its easy to use format. Canva has tons of free, premade
templates that are so easy to customize.”

[Mike's avatar][Mike.][39] on [Fast Growing Trees][40]

### Nice plants, and great service!

“I was a little reluctant to order live plants over the internet but was pleasantly surprised. They
came quickly and in good condition. Unfortunately, a couple of them didn't make it but the customer
service was great in helping me try to save them, then ultimately ended up sending replacements.
Everything is looking good now and I'm very happy with the process and results. Thanks.”

[Natasha A's avatar][Natasha A.][41] on [MAC Cosmetics][42]

### Great Quality; Substandard Practices

“Love the quality, because not many cover the color wheel as effectively as this brand does, but
their practices and stance on animal testing is sad. They use carmine for their reds; beetles have
no place on my lips. Other ingredients are less than satisfactory too. Sad they don't devote enough
resources to produce the same level of product without scary, cancer-causing ingredients. :(”

[Nelson A's avatar][Nelson A.][43] on [Uber][44]

### Very unreliable

“I have a temp medical condition that prevents me from driving, still have to do errands. Taxis in
my area are unreliable & don't take cards. So I thought I'd try Uber. Downloaded their app, entered
info they asked for; scheduled a car, waited past due time, got a cancellation notice for no funds
(I gave them my credit card); tried to re-schedule, same issue. Each time the notice gave an address
2 numbers off of mine but close so I know no car came. There is no way to contact anyone by phone or
online to help resolve the issue. Never again.”

[Nikita N's avatar][Nikita N.][45] on [Coinbase][46]

### My account got closed all of a sudden

unwillingness to share the reasons for terminating the account. Possibly some discriminatory
